titleNative: 鬼売れアイドルが今日も私を推してくる
synopsis: Unpopular underground idol and actress, Enatsu Sayuki, faces her work diligently everyday to achieve her dreams of making it big in the world of acting. ...However, for some reason, the superstar idol Sera Touma—who should be her rival—becomes her biggest fan!! Adorable enough to make Sayuki jealous, Sera takes every chance to passionately declare her love, throwing Sayuki’s life into chaos. Will Sayuki be able to achieve her dreams? And what will become of the one-sided love(?) between Sera and Sayuki…!? The curtain rises on the clash between these young talents in the fierce age of idol showbiz—let the show begin!! (Source: Bunkasha, translated)

synopsis: Cute but dumb as hell… and somehow still the strongest! ...Reincarnated as an ostrich beastkin with innate physical ability?! With intelligence from my previous life, I lead a flock through a monster-filled hellscape just to stay alive… One day, after saving a party of human adventurers from certain doom, I finally made contact with the civilized world I had dreamed of!!! Unlike the uncommunicative ostrich-kin I'm used to, I'm overjoyed to meet people I can actually talk to… However....! Strong, silly, and completely out of control... Watch out, the ostrich beastkin is on a rampage!

synopsis: "Priest...may I pray?" The girl who came to church was Saint Reina Laurel, the one who would one day save the world. Reincarnated as Clael Byrne, a mob priest in the world of an otome game, I met her at a temple in a rural town. Her emaciated body and shabby clothes—to save Reina from the oppression of the game's harsh scenario, I decided to become her surrogate parent. I fed her, bathed her, bought her clothes, and showed her the love of a surrogate parent... (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

he Result of the Villainess Striving to Act Like the Heroine to Avoid Her Destruction: Although She Longs for a Lazy Retirement, She's Confused by Entering the Second Prince's Obsessive Love Route
synopsis: In her previous life, she was an overworked office lady trapped in a black company. Now, she’s been reincarnated as Seraphina, the villainess of an otome game! Being the bad guy is way too much work—and after a lifetime of exhausting labor, all she wants in this life is to relax and be lazy forever! Determined to avoid her doom and enjoy endless naps, she sets out to live a slow, carefree life… but for some reason, everyone around her starts to grow fond of her instead!? Before she knows it, she’s fallen right into the overprotective love route! (Source: Shogakukan, translated)

synopsis: Nekota-san is a pet cat that lives happily with its family. The daughter, Ami, is the one who spends the most time around Nekota, but the cat also interacts quite a lot with their family's housewife mother, who is always working, and their salaryman father. This manga follows Nekota-san's happy and funny daily life.

title: Pani Poni
synopsis: Rebecca Miyamoto is a child genius with a Ph.D. from Columbia University, and she is starting as a high school teacher. The students love to tease her from day one, and she doesn't behave much better. Now we follow this class as they strive to get better grades and cope with their new teacher.
